title: The leap seconds: TAI - UTC since 1972 and the date until which the list is known to be complete
provider: IERS Earth Orientation Centre (Bulletin C), as distributed by IANA with the time zone database
credit: Leap seconds: IERS Bulletin C, via IANA

latest.description: the current list (a few kilobytes); fetch with --refresh after each IERS Bulletin C, every six months

format: Text: lines of NTP seconds (from 1900-01-01 00:00 UTC) and TAI - UTC in seconds; '#@' gives the expiry, the NTP second until which the list is known to be complete. Read by the metrology domain's C++ (time/leap_seconds.hpp).
licence: Public domain (the time zone database and its data files are in the public domain).
citation: IERS Bulletin C; leap-seconds.list, IANA time zone database, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/data/leap-seconds.list (retrieved on the date of retrieval.json).
